title: Tool 63 — Tokenized Asset Compliance Pre-Checker
description: Static analysis of ERC-3643 (T-REX) and ERC-1400 token contract metadata JSON. Checks identityRegistry, compliance contract, claimTopic list, forced transfer, recovery address, partition restrictions, and jurisdictional compliance matrix (ESMA/SEC/SAMA/MAS). Client-side. Zero PII.
